purpose: Measure draft-pick efficiency against a dated 12-team 1QB dynasty rookie market reference.

rawDelta.interpretation: descriptive only until round-sensitive normalization and aggregation are applied

roundExpectedDeviation.source: Historical market audit mean absolute pick delta across resolved picks
roundExpectedDeviation.reason: The same raw difference is more informative early and less informative late.

capitalWeights.rule: modest round weight; applied to owner aggregation and coverage only; no single pick can determine a class score

ownerAggregation.weightedMeanFormula: sum(playerScore * capitalWeight) / sum(capitalWeight) over resolved picks
ownerAggregation.score5: capitalWeightedCoverage >= 0.75, at least 2 VALUE-or-stronger picks, at least 1 VALUE-or-stronger pick in rounds 1-2, no STRONG_AGGRESSIVE picks, weighted mean >= 4.25
ownerAggregation.score4: capitalWeightedCoverage >= 0.50, at least 1 VALUE-or-stronger pick, weighted mean >= 3.65, and not score 5
ownerAggregation.score3: no meaningful aggregate positive or negative signal; otherwise the neutral band when weighted mean is >= 2.75
ownerAggregation.score2: at least 1 AGGRESSIVE-or-stronger pick, weighted mean < 2.75, and not score 1
ownerAggregation.score1: capitalWeightedCoverage >= 0.50, at least 2 STRONG_AGGRESSIVE picks or weighted mean <= 1.75

coverage.capitalWeightedFormula: sum(capitalWeight for resolved picks) / sum(capitalWeight for all picks)
coverage.missingPolicy: unresolved picks are omitted from score math and lower coverage/confidence; they are never neutralized

availability.GRADE_AVAILABLE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE: resolvedPicks >= 3, rawCoverage >= 0.75, capitalWeightedCoverage >= 0.75, and source confidence HIGH
availability.VALUE_GRADE_UNAVAILABLE: no compatible primary snapshot or zero resolved picks

timing.rule: timing is retained as provenance and affects confidence only; it never changes a player delta
